header.title: Tokens
header.description: Style tokens: --gem-* CSS variables and helpers in @gem-org/gem-system/tokens.

toolbar.active: Gem System color tokens. Active theme:

preview.body: Toggle the theme to compare light and dark palettes. Dark mode inverts each scale (50 ↔ 950).

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Families × 50–950 scale with the active theme values.

semantic.title: Semantic aliases
semantic.description: Solid, soft, text and border sets for each status tone.

usage.title: Using semantic colors
usage.description: Prefer component variants and semantic tones over palette steps. This keeps intent clear and automatically follows the active theme.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Button variants map interaction intent to the correct color family.

status.title: Compact status
status.description: Badge tones communicate status without selecting palette values manually.

feedback.title: Messages and feedback
feedback.description: Alert status controls the surface, border, text, accent, and icon as a coordinated semantic set.

info.title: Information
info.body: The latest project settings are now available.

error.title: Unable to save
error.body: Correct the highlighted fields and try again.

overrides.title: Overriding colors
overrides.description: Override CSS custom properties after loading the Gem tokens. Apply them to :root for the whole product, to a wrapper for one area, or directly to a component for a one-off customization.

global.title: Global theme override
global.description: Define palette tokens on :root in a stylesheet loaded after tokens.css. Components keep their semantic relationships while using your brand palette.

scoped.title: Scoped override
scoped.description: The preview below changes primary colors only inside its wrapper.

component.title: Single-component override
component.description: Component variables are useful for an isolated exception. Include normal and interactive states so the result remains coherent.
